{{Quote|A mainstay of the Gran diet, but perfectly suitable for anyone wanting a light meal. We toss fragrant goatgrass with Malastarian croutons, houjix cheese crumbles and three-eyed Kinyenian potatoes.|Dex's Diner menu, on its goatgrass salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Malastarian croutons''' were a type of [[crouton]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served the croutons with its [[goatgrass salad]]<ref name="Menu" /> on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malastarian croutons was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
